//: MCP servers the AI Chat command (vicinae/ai-ask) may call, one entry per server, keyed by a short id that prefixes its tool names in the transcript (id__tool). Read by src/capabilities/servers.ts on every launch of the chat — no rebuild to change it — and spawned over stdio the first time a message is sent, so a server that is not needed costs nothing. `enabled: false` is the off switch; a server whose command is missing is reported in a toast and skipped rather than failing the message. Keys starting with // are comments. Design and rationale: docs/vicinae-ai-extensibility-2026-09-14.md §2.4. A server's `description` is appended to each of its tool descriptions — for what the server does not say about itself but the model needs.
